items.name: model-viewer
items.title: Model viewer
items.description: Demand-rendered 3D viewer with lazy loading, keyboard rotation and GLB export. No idle animation loop.
items.docs: Pass this recipe to ModelViewer. Explore in 3D loads the renderer on demand; Download GLB exports the actual geometry and materials. No textures or external model requests.

items.name: model-viewer-demo
items.title: Model viewer demo
items.description: An interactive example with real state changes and accessible controls.
